hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // ""'); echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+(push[[:space:]]+.*[[:space:]]main$|push[[:space:]]+.*[[:space:]]main[[:space:]]|checkout[[:space:]]+main$|reset[[:space:]]+--hard.*[[:space:]]main)' && printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Direct operations on main branch are blocked. Use a feature branch and open a PR."}}\n' || true
